metadata.name: NLU_data
metadata.purpose: Adversarial NLU dataset for the Magdeburg mobility assistant. Each query is designed to test intent recognition, function selection, and entity recognition. Function selection is the deliberate stress point — many queries have a plausible-but-wrong alternative that a single-call mono-agent is likely to pick.
schema_notes: expected.neo4j_functions = the single best graph function (set intersection scoring)
expected.acceptable_alt_functions = functions that also count as correct
expected.entity_resolution = mapping from input mention to canonical Neo4j name
expected.fiware_entity_type / fiware_entity_id = ground truth for sensor queries
expected.query_graph_spec = ground truth filter spec for dynamic_query category
